# CMFM menu header

`cmfm.h`: CMFM's menu interface (`cmfm.menu` 1.2), copied unchanged from the
CMFM repository (`D:\mh world modding\CMFM\include\cmfm\cmfm.h`).
- Copied at CMFM commit `1b7ed306f39ab4cfb8cb2223d8e5941c834e017b` (tag `al-patch-1`).
- The header last changed in commit `95a0ffae2a3a2aa2433435839988b242e094053d`.
- Licence: MIT, CMFM project (`LICENSE`, copied from its repository).

To update it, copy the new header and record the commit here.

CMFM ("Configuration Menu For Mods") is an Astera Loader plugin. It adds a
**Mods** page to the game's own menus. The mod uses it when it is installed
and runs without it otherwise.
